text: Hello, I'm staying with my sister this week and helping out with her little girl who is 3, my sister is away for work til friday so it's me holding the fort. Her temprature tonight was 39.9, I took it twice to be sure because the first time she was wriggling about and I wasnt sure I had it under her arm properly, but it came out the same both times. She also hasnt done a poo in three days now which she is quite grumpy about, she keeps saying her bottom is 'stuck' and gets cross when I ask her if she needs the potty. On top of that her eczema has flared up, the dry patches behind her knees and on her wrists are worse than usual and she's been scratching at them, I've put her usual cream on but its still itchy. I know none of this is an emergancy as such but with the temperature being that high I thought I should check with someone rather than just guess, my sister usually deals with all this and I dont want to get it wrong. Thanks very much for any advice, no rush.
